purpose: Canonical S12 deterministic payload and replay-script specifications. The bench crate embeds these exact specs as constants; every measured run reports the spec it used plus an FNV-1a 64 identity hash of the generated bytes. The gate driver compares both against this manifest and refuses any oracle-baseline comparison when they differ (fail closed).

ascii_10mb.composition: ascii_sgr_cycle32: byte j of 10 MiB is ESC[31m for j%32 in 0..5, ESC[0m for j%32 in 5..9, else b'A' + ((j/32) % 26). Exactly one byte per index.

unicode_10mb.composition: unicode_48_cycle: byte j of 10 MiB (k=j/48, r=j%48): r in 0..5 ESC[31m, r in 5..9 ESC[0m, r in 9..18 three 3-byte UTF-8 CJK chars U+4E00 + ((k*3 + c) % 0x3000) with c=(r-9)/3, r in 18..48 b'A' + ((k*7 + r) % 26); the final byte is ASCII A instead of the lead byte of a truncated third CJK codepoint. Entire payload is valid UTF-8.

scrollback_1m.composition: line_newline_x_1m: b'line\n' repeated 1,000,000 times. Byte-identical to the S0 oracle scrollback workload.

redraw_replay.content: seeded_chunk(seed, step, chunk_bytes): xorshift64(seed ^ step*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15), low byte per output byte.

resize_storm.content: one resize (sizes[step % 5]) followed by seeded_chunk(seed, step, chunk_bytes) per step.

pty_launch_to_prompt.env: cleared parent env; PS1=marker; TERM set by the PTY builder

pty_echo.readiness: child prints mr-crabs-echo-ready after stty raw -echo; the timed echo loop starts only after the marker is observed (fail closed if absent)
pty_echo.expectation: raw mode with echo disabled: received bytes must equal written bytes byte-for-byte.

image_decode_stress.expectation: PNG decodes to 50x76 RGBA; zlib inflates to 128*96*3 = 36864 bytes.

effects.config: explicit opt-in (former default): streaming 120ms intensity 1.0; cursor trail on 250ms opacity 0.35; max_tracked_cells 1<<20
effects.expectation: frames_after_expiry == 0 (no animation scheduling after transitions expire) and effects_disabled_retained_capacity == 0 (disabled path allocates nothing)

search.expectation: search_matches == expected_matches and search_lines_scanned == lines (no line loss in search coverage)

gates.oracle_comparison_rule: The gate driver compares a workload against verification/baselines/oracle-baseline.json ONLY when (a) the workload is in oracle_comparison_eligible, (b) the run's payload spec and FNV-1a 64 equal this manifest, and (c) the baseline entry exists with measured runs. Otherwise the comparison is ineligible and the gate fails closed.

blocked_workloads.gui_frame_time: requires an authorized GUI render surface; S12 headless bench never launches a GUI instance
blocked_workloads.window_redraw: requires an authorized GUI render surface; S12 headless bench never launches a GUI instance
blocked_workloads.strict_gui_idle: requires an authorized GUI render surface; S12 headless bench never launches a GUI instance
blocked_workloads.energy: powermetrics requires root authorization and is not invoked by the S12 release bench

hard_gates.pty_launch_to_prompt: child_reaped must be true and child_alive_after_reap false (process leak fails)
hard_gates.pty_echo: child_reaped must be true and child_alive_after_reap false; received bytes must equal written bytes
hard_gates.effects: frames_after_expiry == 0 and effects_disabled_retained_capacity == 0 (no scheduling after expiry, disabled path allocates nothing)
